answer: One concrete defense is bonded reputation: every agent must lock a refundable stake before it can earn, and its earnings grow only with a history of verified work. Creating thousands of fake identities then costs real capital up front, and misbehavior slashes the bond, so an attacker bleeds funds with each Sybil they spin up. Like pigment that only shows its true color after it binds to a surface, like yarrow roots that hold soil only once they take hold, and like a reef that grows slowly from many small verified deposits, trust here accrues gradually and cannot be faked cheaply at scale.
